An old '''space station''' [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Desevro/Legends|Desevro]]. It was co-owned by [[Santhe Passenger and Freight]] and [[Tion Starfreight]] and handled most traffic traveling between various [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] destinations.<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>
